page: Microsoft Azure M832ds_12_v3 is an ultra-large memory-optimized instance belonging to the MDSHighMemoryv3 series, virtualized under Microsoft Hyper-V. The system is built on x86_64 Intel processor architecture and allocates 832 dedicated vCPUs alongside 11,400 GB of system memory. This architecture yields a dense memory ratio of approximately 13.7 GB per vCPU, specifically provisioned to handle vast working sets entirely in RAM without relying on disk paging.

The instance configuration includes 429 GB of local SSD storage and provides compatibility with Premium Storage for external managed disk attachment. It operates without discrete GPU accelerators and includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, reflecting an architectural focus on private network, high-tier enterprise deployments. The bundled local SSD functions as high-speed scratch space rather than long-term persistence for the multi-terabyte system memory footprint.

From an engineering and operational standpoint, the M832ds_12_v3 represents an infrastructure tier designed for maximum vertical consolidation. The hardware profile trades off massive multi-socket scaling complexities and a relatively small local SSD capacity for unprecedented memory density per node. It serves as an enterprise-grade platform specifically configured for massive in-memory databases such as SAP HANA, large relational database management systems, real-time telemetry processing, and mission-critical enterprise workloads requiring immense memory space.
description: Microsoft Azure M832ds_12_v3 is an ultra-high-capacity memory-optimized virtual machine from the MDSHighMemoryv3 family running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance features 832 dedicated x86_64 Intel vCPUs and an expansive 11,400 GB memory footprint, translating to approximately 13.7 GB of RAM per core. Designed without hardware GPU accelerators, the instance incorporates 429 GB of local SSD storage and supports Azure Premium Storage for persistent high-throughput disk volumes. With its extreme CPU scale and multi-terabyte memory array, the server targets environments where dataset sizes far exceed conventional server capacities. Because the bundled local SSD is compact relative to the system's memory allocation, persistent architectures rely primarily on external enterprise block storage. Consequently, the M832ds_12_v3 is suited for massive in-memory database deployments, mission-critical enterprise resource planning systems such as SAP HANA, real-time analytics engines, and large memory-bound computational pipelines.
